key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automatic monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Gen AI.
Capable of detecting objects and unusual situations, enabling proactive responses.
Live recording and real-time data processing for immediate insights.
Advanced object detection capabilities including various entities like vehicles, personnel, and anomalies.
Customizable alert system allowing users to set specific notifications at their fingertips.
Clients report significant reductions in human monitoring efforts and improved detection of unforeseen events.
Positive feedback highlights the system's ability to enhance CCTV utility and operational safety.
Ongoing anticipation for future updates and innovations from Aksha.
Aksha can be installed on any standard CCTV camera that supports RTSP links.
Installation involves connecting to an edge device within the same network as the DVR/NVR.
Compatible with a variety of camera types, ensuring flexibility in deployment.
Collaboration with NDIL has led to the development of a customized version of Aksha for worker safety.
Integration of Gen AI to enhance features and improve anomaly detection capabilities.
Architectural improvements for better performance and scalability, including cloud and edge computing solutions.
Ongoing enhancements to support multi-edge architecture for improved camera management.
Centralized GUI for monitoring multiple cameras running on different hardware devices.
Future plans include expanding functionalities and optimizing user experience.
For more information, visit: https://aksha.algoanalytics.com/
Contact us at: aksha@algoanalytics.com
Office Location: Alacrity India Innovation Centre, Pune, India.
